items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Layout is clean, but single-letter names are used in business logic (`h hash.Hash`, `k := make([]byte, 32)`, `w`). Exported funcs/types have no doc comments. decodeBase64 stores decoded data in a variable named `rawURLErr`. Header bytes `0x4F, 0x44, 0x01` are inline with no comment.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: LoadKey copies the decode-then-check-32-bytes block three times (env/file/literal). It also repeats the passphrase and salt checks that validateKeySource already does. The 4-encoding fallback in decodeBase64 is speculative. Uses argon2 instead of the vendored pbkdf2 the conventions specify.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are wrapped, but EncryptWriter calls `panic(err)`. Inline magic values: `10*ChunkSize`, `argon2.IDKey(..., 1, 64*1024, 4, 32)`. Write returns 0 after a partial flush. Validate() over-checks literal key bytes, which broke the hidden tests TestConfigValidateValidLiteral and TestConfigValidateCaseInsensitiveSource.

items.name: Interface changes limited to the specified ones
items.name_zh: 接口变更仅限题目要求
items.evidence: Mandated signatures changed and unencrypted output is unchanged. But storage.PathGenerator keeps its old signature and hardcodes `EnsureFileName(filename, gzip, false, unique)`, so callers are wrapped, not updated as the conventions require. Also adds an extra `WithEncryption` option.
